desc: Update the calculation of `total_A` to use the closed-form formula derived in the notes to avoid $O(WH)$ complexity.
Implement modular arithmetic and precompute factorials/inverses for combinations up to $W+H+2$.
Write a function to compute $Out(x, y) = \binom{W-x+H-y+2}{H-y+1} - 1$.
Write a function to compute $In(L, y)$ using the derived formula $\binom{y+L+1}{L} - \binom{y-H+L}{L}$.
Write a function to compute $In(x, D)$ using the derived formula $\binom{x+D+1}{D}$.
Calculate $|B|$ by summing $In(L, y) \times Out(L, y)$ for $y \in [D, U]$ and $In(x, D) \times Out(x, D)$ for $x \in [L, R]$, subtracting the corner term.
